en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sahl, from his father who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about a man who went over to his wife during a Month of Ramazan, and he was a traveler. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Sahl [from his father] who has said the following: “
I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who experiences sexual relation with his wife in the month of Ramadan during a journey. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’”
